info.name: CRONOS — Digital Time Capsule
info.description:
Collection for the CRONOS serverless API (dead man's switch time capsule).

Set the collection variable `base_url` to your deployed API URL (e.g. https://<api-id>.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com) or to http://localhost:3000 when running `serverless offline`.

After creating a capsule, copy its `id` from the 201 response into the `capsule_id` collection variable to test get / update / delete / checkin against a real item.

variable.description: Base URL of the API: deployed HTTP API URL or http://localhost:3000 for serverless offline
Id of an existing capsule (copy it from the create response)

request.description: Creates a new ACTIVE time capsule. Expected: 201 with the created item. Copy the returned `id` into the `capsule_id` variable.
Payload without "message". Expected: 400 with {"error": "\"message\" is required and must be text"}.
Lists capsules using Scan with pagination. Query params: `limit` (default 20) and `lastKey` for the next page. Expected: 200 with {"items": [...], "lastKey": ...}.
Retrieves a single capsule. Expected: 200 with the item. Requires a real id in `capsule_id`.
Requests an id that does not exist. Expected: 404 with {"error": "Capsule not found"}.
Updates message, recipientEmail and checkInIntervalHours of an ACTIVE capsule (ConditionExpression). Expected: 200 with the updated item; 404 if the id does not exist or is not ACTIVE.
Deletes a capsule (ConditionExpression attribute_exists). Expected: 200 with {"message": "Capsule deleted successfully"}; 404 if the id does not exist.

Registers activity for an ACTIVE capsule: resets lastCheckIn to now and nextReview to now + checkInIntervalHours. Expected: 200 with {"message": "Check-in registered", "nextReview": "..."}; 404 if not found or not ACTIVE.
Queries the StatusNextReviewIndex GSI for all capsules with the given status (ACTIVE, DELIVERED or CANCELLED). Expected: 200 with {"items": [...], "count": N}.
No `status` query param. Expected: 400 with {"error": "Missing required query parameter: status"}.
